description: Shorti(쇼티) for «check my take» or «내가 찍은 거 봐줘». The person's own video checked against its format's hits. `url` (their posted Reels, TikTok or Short): Shorti's page to paste it on, the first 3 free. `format`: a link to upload on their phone. Then `token` until `shared`: their feedback, its cue check first. Call it feedback (피드백); a likeness is not a forecast of views.

recipe_ref.description: A recipe tool's recipe_ref, tying the take to it.

token.description: The token a previous call gave.

url.description: Their posted Reels, TikTok or Shorts link.

name: shorti_check_link
title: Check a take
